locale.title: Default locale
locale.description: Returns the fallback locale used when none is active or a translation is missing.

asset.title: Localized asset
asset.description: Resolves an asset for the active locale, falling back to the default locale.

basic.title: Basic key
basic.description: Resolves a translation key for the active locale.

interpolation.title: Interpolation
interpolation.description: Replaces placeholders in the string using the params object.

count.title: Plural + number formatting
count.description: A numeric count selects the plural branch and is locale-formatted.

branch.title: Plural fallback
branch.description: A plural with no matching branch falls back to the "other" form.

function.title: Function value
function.description: A translation value can be a function that receives the params object.

locale.title: Explicit locale override
locale.description: The third argument resolves a locale other than the active one.

raw.title: t.raw()
raw.description: Returns the underlying value instead of stringifying it.

locale.title: t.raw() locale override
locale.description: The third argument reads a raw value from another locale.

fallback.title: t.raw() fallback
fallback.description: Returns the fallback when the key does not exist.

array.title: t.array()
array.description: Returns a typed array from the dictionary.

fallback.title: t.array() fallback
fallback.description: Returns the fallback array when the key is missing or not an array.

plural.title: t.plural()
plural.description: Returns the CLDR plural category for a count.

localize.title: t.localize()
localize.description: Picks a value from an inline locale dictionary.

missing.title: Missing key
missing.description: Unknown keys resolve to the key itself.
